name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.8.9
body:
**TV Control**
- Currently supports LG webOS TVs over the Network.
- LG and Sony TV Control via serial using Port1 or Port2. 
  - Must use a TRS crossover cable.
  - Easiest method is to combine a "3.5mm to RCA male" <-> "RCA female to 3.5mm" cables together connecting red to white RCA ends.
  - Retrieval of custom LG TV HDMI input names not supported over serial, only Network.
- Power On supported by Wake On LAN packet sent when MAC Address provided.
  - On your LG TV, Enable: Settings → All Settings → Connection → Mobile Connection Management → TV On With Mobile → Turn On via Wi-Fi. 
  - Also Enable "Quick Start+" for faster network wake-up.
  - Power On / Wake On LAN may not work depending on your home network setup.
- Basic remote controls such as d-pad, input selection, volume control, home, settings.
- When enabled, shows up in the upper right top bar with a "TV" button.
- AUX8 + Power now uses the configured TV Control method, when using the IR Receiver.

**Automation**
- With TV Control you can fully utilize the "On detected Profile Change..." setting to:
  - Wake RetroTink
  - Power On TV with option to change HDMI input on TV 
  - Do Both 

**IR Remote**
- Native RetroTink-4K and RetroTink-6X CE IR Remote Support, including automatic management of the RetroTink's ir-remote.txt config file.
